author: eng-lead
text: Heads up: the auth service is throwing 500s on roughly 5% of login attempts since 14:00 UTC yesterday. Root cause appears to be a connection pool exhaustion in the Redis layer. We have a hotfix in review but it hasn't shipped yet. This is impacting checkout for enterprise accounts.

author: scrum-bot
text: Sprint 42 daily status: 18 of 23 story points completed. Velocity on track. No impediments reported by any team members. Stand-up notes attached.

author: vp-sales
text: The Acme Corp deal is at risk. Their CTO is asking why the SSO feature we promised in Q2 isn't on the roadmap. This is a $2.4M renewal. I need a status and a response by EOD today or we risk losing the account.

text: Weekly data pipeline health report: all jobs completed within SLA. No data quality issues detected. Pipeline latency improved 12% vs last week. Full metrics in the dashboard.

author: infra-lead
text: Production Kubernetes cluster is running at 94% CPU on the web tier. If we hit the same traffic spike as last Friday, we're likely to see OOM kills. Cluster autoscaler is enabled but provisioning takes ~8 min. We should consider pre-scaling before the weekend.
